unknown-host: benign: a HEAD 404 from Rust carries content-type text/plain (Bun omits it because it has no body)
no-host-header: intentional: Bun answers a missing/empty Host with its 50 KB HTML dev error page (500); Rust sends a small plain-text 400 (see intentional-no-html-error-page)
bare-domain-redirect: benign: Rust omits content-length: 0 on the HEAD 302 (the GET/POST 302s are identical)
upstream-hop-by-hop-headers: intentional/benign: Rust strips the upstream's hop-by-hop connection and keep-alive headers; Bun forwards them
cpu-header-formatting: benign: Number.toFixed(3) of 1e21 is "1e+21" in JS; Rust prints all digits. Every realistic value matches
response-cap-stream: benign: a streamed body over the cap aborts the connection on both; Bun resets before the headers, Rust after them (and counts resBytes up to the abort rather than the whole chunk)
timeout-mid-body: intentional: the request deadline now covers response headers only, so a body that stalls past it completes (see intentional-deadline-covers-headers-only)
cache-status-codes: benign: for a 304 the app's content-length is dropped by Rust (a 304 has no body)
assets-encoded-paths: intentional: malformed %-sequences give Bun's HTML dev error page (500); Rust sends a small plain-text 400
assets-malformed-percent-encoding: intentional: malformed %-sequences give Bun's HTML dev error page (500); Rust sends a small plain-text 400
assets-head: benign: Rust adds content-disposition: filename="..." to a HEAD of an asset (Bun adds it for ranged GETs only)
assets-range-and-other-request-headers: intentional: Bun answers the Range with 206 but logs 200 and the full size; Rust logs 206 and the slice size
assets-redirects: benign: Rust omits content-length: 0 on the HEAD redirect
assets-manifest-without-files: benign: an assets.json without a files object crashes Bun's handler into the HTML dev error page; Rust falls through to the sprout
assets-manifest-missing-file-on-disk: intentional: a manifest entry whose file is missing gives Bun's HTML dev error page; Rust sends a small plain-text 500 and logs no asset fields
assets-manifest-rules-shapes: benign: after a _headers rule unsets content-type Bun re-adds text/plain (Bun's Response default); Rust sends none
ws-handshake-variants: benign: Rust forwards an Upgrade: h2c request (Bun's fetch fails it with 502), answers a bad Sec-WebSocket-Version with 400 (Bun 426), and strips hop-by-hop upgrade headers from a POST (the fake app 101s it under Bun)
reload-sighup-invalid-file: intentional: SIGHUP with an invalid routes.json kills Bun (unhandled rejection); Rust keeps running (see intentional-sighup-invalid-routes)
activation-malformed-json: benign: the error text of an unparsable activation request is the JSON parser's own message (engine specific)
assets-headers-custom-content-type: benign: after a _headers rule unsets content-type Bun re-adds text/plain (Bun's Response default); Rust sends none
forward-host-path-query: intentional: a path that starts with // is forwarded as received (Rust); Bun drops the first slash upstream (//seen//x arrives as /seen//x). See intentional-leading-double-slash-path
assets-directory-and-extensionless: intentional: a path that starts with // is forwarded as received (Rust); Bun drops the first slash upstream (//seen//x arrives as /seen//x). See intentional-leading-double-slash-path
request-body-roundtrip: benign, timing dependent: Bun re-frames a small chunked request body with content-length when it has all of it by the time it forwards; Rust always forwards the framing the client used (chunked)
